results.name: merge keeps the upper-left most data (reading order), clears the rest, keeps covered formatting; unmerge leaves value top-left
selection expands to whole merged areas (fixed point); arrow keys treat a merge as one cell; partial paste/sort refused
insert/delete rows & cols repair merges, validations and frozen panes
borders: presets set the right edges; shared edge shows the heavier side; 'none' clears; per-cell storage
data validation: list (literal + range, case-insensitive), whole/decimal/date/textLength operators, custom (relative), blanks, rollback
validation hardening: 255-char typed list limit, sqref parsing, hostile JSON; merges/validations/borders persist through JSON
